batch.note: Indicative only: what the Monday paper batch would hold if it were picked from today's list. The real paper cohort is frozen each Monday and sized with 60-day realized volatility; today's weights use ATR as a stand-in.

concentration.note: Tech share of this paper batch vs the 40% batch rule. The live v2.8 figure is tech as a share of the stock held outside the owner-managed core.

cohortNote: No paper cohort yet. The first one is frozen on the next Monday run; results stay descriptive until 12 Monday cohorts exist.

backtest.note: Daily bars 2021-11-15 to 2026-11-16 (signals 2022-09-01 to 2026-11-13), 66 fixed current names, price rules only, net of 10 bps slippage per side, 5.25% margin interest on the financed share and gap-through-stop fills. Hypothetical and in-sample on today's names (survivorship bias); not proven out-of-sample. Survivorship probe: delisted-name price history is not available on this feed, so no delisted-inclusive test has been run.

notes: PAPER ONLY. No ticket, alert, order or live rule reads this file. Live Apex stays on rules v2.8.
Thresholds are the approved v2.9-paper-1 starting points under test; none was loosened to produce picks.

Scores come from Robinhood scanner columns for every stock in the universe: price, 20/50/70/100/200-day averages, 3- and 6-month closes and ranges, RSI-14, ATR-14, latest-quarter revenue growth (year over year), trailing P/E, next earnings date.
Revenue growth is the latest reported quarter vs the same quarter a year earlier. A stock with no figure fails closed.
A reversal (setup C) also needs growth improving quarter over quarter; that is checked from company financials only for names that pass every other test, and fails closed when unchecked.
The earnings window counts weekdays; market holidays are not modelled.
Near and Emerging lists show the top 25 by score; the funnel carries the full counts.
